passages.text: The discussion of financial condition and results of our operations that follows provides information that will assist the reader in understanding our Consolidated Financial Statements, the changes in certain key items in those financial statements from year to year, and the primary factors that accounted for those changes, as well as how certain accounting principles, policies and estimates affect our Consolidated Financial Statements. This discussion should be read in conjunction with our Consolidated Financial Statements and the related notes that appear elsewhere in this document. This section generally discusses the results of operations for the fiscal year ended October 31, 2025 compared to the fiscal year ended October 31, 2024. For a discussion of fiscal year ended October 31, 2024 compared to the fiscal year ended October 31, 2023, please refer to Part II, Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended October 31, 2024. 32 Table of Contents HP INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations OVERVIEW HP delivers innovative and sustainable devices, services, and subscriptions for personal computing, printing, 3D printing, hybrid work, gaming and other related technologies. We have three reportable segments: Personal Systems, Printing, and Corporate Investments. The Personal Systems segment offers commercial and consumer desktops, notebooks and workstations (including HP’s portfolio of AI PCs and workstations), thin clients, retail POS systems, displays, hybrid systems, software, solutions including endpoint security, and services. The Printing segment provides consumer and commercial printer hardware, supplies, solutions and services. Corporate Investments include certain business incubation and investment projects. • In Personal Systems, our long-term strategic focus is on: ◦ profitable growth through innovation, market segmentation and simplification of our portfolio; ◦ enhanced innovation in multi-operating systems, multi-architecture, customer segments and other key attributes; ◦ investing in endpoint services and solutions. We are focused on services, including Device-as-a-Service, as the market shifts to subscription-based solutions, and accelerating in attractive adjacencies such as hybrid systems; and ◦ driving innovation to enable productivity and collaboration, with AI PCs and workstations playing a critical role in the transformation of how people live and work. • In Printing, our long-term strategic focus is on: ◦ offering innovative, intelligent printing experiences and subscription-based solutions designed to securely serve consumer and SMB customers through our Instant Ink Services and HP All-In Plan, as well as large enterprises through our Managed Print Services solutions; ◦ providing digital printing solutions for industrial graphics segments and applications including commercial publishing, labels, packaging, and textiles; and ◦ expanding our footprint in 3D printing across digital manufacturing and strategic applications. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds capital expenditure plus dividends, and free cash flow also covers total shareholder distributions, so HP funds its hardware and supplies business internally without incremental borrowing.

Interest coverage on operating income remains solidly above unity, and EBITDA-based coverage is similarly comfortable, reflecting a debt stack dominated by fixed-rate senior unsecured global notes rather than short-dated bank lines.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits above the sector median and has risen year on year, while net leverage is also above the sector median and drifting higher, leaving thin headroom to the next risk band on a net-debt basis.

The debt note shows meaningful near-term maturities, including the current portion of long-term debt and notes due within the coming years, so refinancing depends on continued access to unsecured markets at acceptable coupons.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow relative to debt is below the sector median and has weakened year on year, and operating cash flow to debt likewise trails peers, indicating comparatively slower deleveraging from internal generation.

The current ratio is below one and well under the sector median, so HP relies on recurring cash conversion and revolving liquidity rather than a strong working-capital cushion to meet maturing obligations.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal on both leverage and cash-flow tiers, but the cushion is narrow: modest EBITDA erosion or added debt would push leverage past the next boundary, so the profile is stable rather than strongly defensive.

Operating margin is well below the sector median and declined year on year, so profitability pressure in Personal Systems and Printing is the key swing factor for coverage and for the pace of debt reduction.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流穩健地超過資本支出加股息，而自由現金流亦足以覆蓋股東總分派，因此 HP 以內部資金支持其硬件及耗材業務，毋須增加借貸。
以營運收入計算的利息覆蓋率穩固地高於一，而以 EBITDA 計算的覆蓋率同樣充裕，反映其債務結構以固定利率的高級無抵押全球票據為主，而非短期銀行信貸額度。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿高於行業中位數，並按年上升，而淨槓桿亦高於行業中位數且持續走高，以淨債務計算，距離下一個風險區間的緩衝空間有限。
債務附註顯示有相當規模的短期到期債務，包括長期債務的流動部分及未來數年內到期的票據，因此再融資取決於能否繼續以可接受的票息進入無抵押市場。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流相對債務的比率低於行業中位數，並按年轉弱，而營運現金流相對債務的比率亦落後同業，顯示相較之下，以內部產生的現金去槓桿的速度較慢。
流動比率低於一，且遠低於行業中位數，因此 HP 依賴持續的現金轉換及循環流動性，而非強勁的營運資金緩衝，以應付到期債務。

overall_credit_view.text: 在槓桿及現金流兩個層級上，指示性財務風險狀況均為極低，但緩衝空間狹窄：EBITDA 輕微侵蝕或債務增加，便會令槓桿超越下一個界線，因此該狀況屬穩定而非強力防禦。
營運利潤率遠低於行業中位數，並按年下跌，因此 Personal Systems 及 Printing 的盈利能力壓力，是影響覆蓋率及減債步伐的關鍵變數。
